description: SubsetTools is a Python package developed by the HydroFrame project to extract regional inputs and outputs from the national ParFlow modelling system. It subsets hydrogeological and climate-forcing datasets and supplies configured run scripts for a chosen model domain. The documentation includes workflows for both ParFlow-CONUS1 and ParFlow-CONUS2. A modeller can use it to prepare local groundwater and surface-water simulations for water-supply or irrigation studies. Coverage is the contiguous United States, with spatial and temporal detail inherited from the selected national model products. Code and example workflows are freely available through GitHub under MIT. A limitation is that access to the supporting HydroFrame data service requires an account, and larger ParFlow runs may require substantial computing resources. ParFlow remains a separate solver. No directly related catalogue record was established. This review verified public software documentation without creating an account, downloading model inputs or running ParFlow.
